subject.title: fix(cron): bound cron quarantine sidecar file reads

question: Should cron quarantine overflow recovery retain only one archive and replace the prior archived quarantine data on later overflows?
rationale: The quarantine file is documented as material kept for later repair or review, while the proposed fixed archive deliberately bounds disk use by discarding the preceding archive on each subsequent overflow.

options.title: Accept one retained archive
options.body: Keep the fixed archive path and document that quarantine overflow preserves only the most recent pre-overflow sidecar to prevent unbounded disk growth.

options.title: Preserve a different recovery contract
options.body: Define and implement a bounded retention or operator-recovery policy that keeps the required quarantine history without allowing unbounded sidecar growth.

options.title: Pause the recovery change
options.body: Land only the bounded read/write rejection behavior and defer archive rotation until the retention contract is agreed.

recommendation.title: Accept one retained archive
recommendation.body: Keep the fixed archive path and document that quarantine overflow preserves only the most recent pre-overflow sidecar to prevent unbounded disk growth.
